fullTextEN: Hello, everyone!
I am Teacher Bella.
I am from Taiwan.

fullTextZH: 在台湾，你可能会看到一些庙。
fullTextEN: In Taiwan, you might see some temples.

fullTextZH: 这些庙里面都有不一样的神。
fullTextEN: Inside these temples, there are different gods.
Some gods,
can help you make a lot of money.
Some gods,

fullTextZH: 可以让你考试考得很好，
fullTextEN: can help you do well in exams,
become smarter. Some gods,
can keep you safe and sound.

fullTextZH: 今天呢，我要介绍的这个神呢，
fullTextEN: Today, the god I want to introduce,

fullTextZH: 他可以帮你找到男朋友、女朋友。
fullTextEN: can help you find a boyfriend or girlfriend.
That's right, today,

fullTextZH: 我要介绍的这个神就是中国的爱神，
fullTextEN: the god I want to introduce is China's love god,
Yue Lao.
In Taiwanese temples,
you will see this god,

fullTextZH: 他就是那个手上拿着一本书，
fullTextEN: he is the one holding a book,

fullTextZH: 手里拿着一条红线的爱神。
fullTextEN: holding a red string in his hand.

fullTextZH: 那月老要怎么帮我们找到男朋友，
fullTextEN: So how does the old man under the moon help us find a boyfriend,
or a girlfriend?
First, you need to go to the temple of the old man under the moon,
then prepare these three things.
The first thing is candy.
Why do you need to prepare candy?

fullTextZH: 因为月老吃了糖果以后，
fullTextEN: Because after the old man under the moon eats the candy,
his mouth will become very sweet,

fullTextZH: 所以呢，他就会在你以后的男朋友，
fullTextEN: so he will say nice things in front of your future boyfriend,
or girlfriend,
saying nice things.
The second thing,
is flowers, preferably red ones,
because flowers symbolize love.
The third thing is this,
this is called a date,
meaning,

fullTextZH: 你可以早点找到你的男朋友，
fullTextEN: you can find your boyfriend sooner,
or girlfriend.
The most important thing,
Just take out a piece of paper,
write it down,

fullTextZH: 你想要的男朋友、女朋友是怎么样的。
fullTextEN: what kind of boyfriend or girlfriend you want.

fullTextZH: 你可以写：我想要很高的男朋友，
fullTextEN: You can write: I want a very tall boyfriend,

fullTextZH: 你也可以写：我想要很帅的男朋友，
fullTextEN: You can also write: I want a very handsome boyfriend,

fullTextZH: 你也可以写：我想要很有钱的男朋友。
fullTextEN: You can also write: I want a very rich boyfriend.
Yuelao, Yuelao,

fullTextZH: 请你给我一个很高、很帅的男朋友，嗯，
fullTextEN: Please give me a very tall and handsome boyfriend, hmm,

fullTextZH: 差不多像Michael Jordan一样高，然后差不多像...
fullTextEN: Almost as tall as Michael Jordan, and then almost like...
Ah, as handsome as Tom Cruise, ah,
If rich,
as rich as Elon Musk.
Yes, yes, yes, this would be great!
Please, please, please, please!
Hmm, hmm, hmm, this person,
is too greedy, really troublesome!

fullTextZH: 最后呢，月老如果觉得你说的很好，
fullTextEN: Finally, if Yuelao thinks you spoke well,

fullTextZH: 他就会给你一条红线和一颗糖果。
fullTextEN: he will give you a red thread and a candy.

fullTextZH: 红线呢，你可以放在你的包包里面，
fullTextEN: The red thread, you can put it in your bag,

fullTextZH: 让你很快找到你的男朋友、女朋友。
fullTextEN: so you can quickly find your boyfriend or girlfriend.
As for the candy, after you eat it,
It will help you quickly find happiness.
In Taiwan,

fullTextZH: 也有很多有名的月老庙。
fullTextEN: there are also many famous Yue Lao temples.
These Yue Lao temples,

fullTextZH: 都有很多外国人从国外飞到台湾，
fullTextEN: all have many foreigners flying from abroad to Taiwan,

fullTextZH: 请月老帮他们找男朋友、女朋友。
fullTextEN: asking Yue Lao to help them find boyfriends or girlfriends.
So, when you come to Taiwan,
if you go to a Yue Lao temple,
you might see,

fullTextZH: 很多男生和女生一起的照片，
fullTextEN: many photos of boys and girls together,
or after they get married,

fullTextZH: 回来月老庙给月老糖果、饼干。
fullTextEN: returning to the Yue Lao temple to give Yue Lao candy and cookies.
Speaking of this,

fullTextZH: 你是不是觉得台湾的月老非常厉害呢？
fullTextEN: don't you think Taiwan's Yue Lao is amazing?
A while ago,

fullTextZH: 还有一部很有名的电影叫做《月老》。
fullTextEN: there was also a famous movie called 'Yue Lao'.
This movie,

fullTextZH: 是在说这个男生死了以后，
fullTextEN: is about this guy who, after he died,
became a Yue Lao.
In the movie,

fullTextZH: 告诉我们他怎么成为月老，
fullTextEN: It tells us how he became the matchmaker,

fullTextZH: 然后帮助大家找到真爱的故事。
fullTextEN: and then helps everyone find true love stories.
If you find it interesting,

fullTextZH: 你也可以在网络上找找看。
fullTextEN: you can also search online.
After watching,
you will know,

fullTextZH: 为什么台湾人这么喜欢月老。
fullTextEN: why Taiwanese people like the matchmaker so much.

fullTextZH: 好啦，这就是今天介绍的月老的故事。
fullTextEN: Alright, this is the story of the matchmaker introduced today.

fullTextZH: 你们觉得这个是迷信还是真的呢？
fullTextEN: Do you think this is superstition or real?

fullTextZH: 在你们的国家有没有这种特别的神呢？
fullTextEN: Is there such a special god in your country?
If you come to Taiwan next time,

fullTextZH: 你会不会想去月老庙看一看，
fullTextEN: would you want to visit the matchmaker temple,

fullTextZH: 请他帮你找男朋友、女朋友呢？
fullTextEN: and ask him to help you find a boyfriend or girlfriend?

fullTextZH: 欢迎你在下面留言告诉我哦！
fullTextEN: You're welcome to leave a comment below and tell me!

fullTextZH: 那我们就下支影片见吧，再见！
fullTextEN: Then let's meet in the next video, goodbye!
Bye!
